units.source_text: 管他妈的，横冲直撞，从正面进攻……

en.t: To hell with it, charge straight ahead and attack from the front...

units.source_text: 翻过那儿，就是村落外面了……

en.t: Once I get over there, I will be outside the village...

units.source_text: 以后也许会后悔，成败就看此招……

en.t: I may regret it later, but success or failure depends on this move...

units.source_text: ……就这一瞬间，你现在不抓可就来不及啦……

en.t: ... This is the moment; if you do not seize it now, it will be too late...

units.source_text: 乘机抓住下一个瞬间，后面就没法追上来了！

en.t: Take the chance and seize the next instant, and those behind will never be able to catch up!
